Container.Name: newznab-tmux
Container.Overview: All-in-one Usenet indexer with automatic scanning, full-text search, and API access - all services included in one container.
Container.Description:
Newznab-tmux is a high-performance, self-contained Usenet indexer built on the Laravel framework. This all-in-one container includes everything needed: PHP application, Nginx web server, MariaDB database, Redis cache, Meilisearch indexing, and Supervisor job management.
All services run inside a single container with persistent storage, making deployment simple and efficient.
Key Features: - Complete Usenet header scanning - Full-text search via Meilisearch - RESTful API for external integrations - Redis-backed caching and job queuing - Background job processing with Supervisor - MariaDB database backend - Multi-protocol media detection - Self-contained - no external dependencies
Recommended Requirements: - 16GB+ RAM - 4+ CPU cores - 100GB+ storage for indexing - Network access to Usenet providers

Container.Changes:
v6.0 - Minimal Volume Mounts (2 volumes only) - Consolidated all volumes to just 2 mounts for maximum simplicity - /config → All application files (config, .env, storage, cache) - /data → All service data (mysql, redis, meilisearch, logs) - Clean directory structure with subdirectories - Symlinks handle all internal path mappings - Easiest to manage, backups, and troubleshoot
v5.0 - Simplified Volume Structure - Consolidated 6 volumes to 3 clean directories - /config → Application configuration (.env, app config) - /storage → Usenet data (headers, metadata, NZBs) - /data → Service data (mysql, redis, meilisearch, logs) - Matches docker-compose structure for consistency - Easier to navigate and manage on host system
v4.0 - Unraid Native Network Support - Uses Unraid custom network mode for maximum flexibility - Support for both port binding (bridge) and static IP (br0) - Static IP works within your existing network range (e.g., 192.168.9.x) - Simplified Unraid template configuration - Works seamlessly with Unraid's bridge assignment - Auto-credentials on first run with all passwords displayed in logs
v3.0 - Auto-credentials and configurable static IP - Runtime-configurable static IP address - Auto-generate admin user and service passwords on first run - Display all credentials in container logs - Secure password generation (16+ char alphanumeric) - Credentials stored in .env.generated for reference
v2.0 - All-in-one self-contained container - Single container with all services - Nginx, PHP-FPM, MariaDB, Redis, Meilisearch - Supervisor process management - Simplified deployment and configuration - Reduced complexity and resource overhead
v1.0 - Initial Unraid template release - Multi-container orchestration - Separate services for modularity
